overview_description.description:
Adverity is the integrated data platform for connecting, managing and using data at scale.
 
Providing centralised data management for marketing teams, the platform enables businesses to blend disparate datasets such as marketing, advertising, sales and revenue to create a single source of truth over business performance. Through automated connectivity to hundreds of data sources and destinations, unrivaled data transformation options, and powerful data governance features, Adverity is the easiest way to get your data how you want it, where you want it, and when you need it.

Adverity was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Vienna with offices in London and New York, and currently works with leading brands and agencies including Unilever, Bosch, IKEA, Forbes, GroupM, Publicis, and Dentsu.

about_short_description.short_description: Adverity is an integrated data platform for the modern marketer, helping them to connect, manage and use data at scale.

product.name: Adverity Connect
product.description: An enterprise marketing ETL platform that collects data from 600+ sources, transforms and harmonizes metrics, monitors data quality, and delivers trusted data to warehouses and other destinations.

product.name: Adverity Atlas
product.description: A marketing knowledge layer that connects to existing data warehouses and enables governed AI analysis, cross-system investigation, anomaly detection, forecasting, and traceable marketing insights.

product.name: Adverity Dashboards
product.description: An optional reporting and visualization add-on for exploring warehouse data, creating interactive marketing dashboards, distributing scheduled reports, and generating natural-language or AI-assisted insights.
